author: N6rL
content: Implementation: (1) Add import-linter to dev deps. (2) Configure [tool.importlinter] in root pyproject.toml — layers contract: interaction > synthesis > understanding > ingestion. (3) Create .github/workflows/ci.yml — minimal GitHub Actions matrix covering Python (ruff, pyright, pytest fast, lint-imports) and Rust (fmt, clippy, test, cargo-deny). lint-imports runs as uv run lint-imports in the python job. (4) Verify green baseline: uv run lint-imports passes on the M0 skeleton. (5) Negative check: temporarily add a wrong-direction import (alcanzai_ingestion importing from alcanzai_understanding), confirm lint-imports goes red, remove it, confirm green again. Noting import-linter is CI-only per DEV-PIPELINE.md Layer 5 — not wired into pre-commit. The [tool.importlinter] root_packages entry lists all four Python packages; src-layout editable installs via uv sync make them importable.
